description: put.io frontend Renovate policy: daily, three-day release age, patch and minor grouped and automerged after checks, majors behind dashboard approval, digest pinning.

packageRules.description: Group patch and minor updates per manager; majors stay separate
Renovate merges grouped patch, minor, and pin updates itself once every check on the PR passes; majors and digest moves stay manual
GitHub Actions use the ci commit prefix
OpenTofu registry for providers and modules
required_version tracks OpenTofu releases, not Terraform

Container images track upstream on a one-day gate: they are digest-pinned and every bump passes repository checks before it merges, so the three-day window mostly holds back fixes on daily-shipping images
Actions are pinned to a commit digest; one day lets a newly published release settle before the pin moves

Runtime versions move as one PR across managers: the .python-version or node-version pin, the requires-python range, and the image tag fail checks when any one of them moves alone. One three-day gate for every member, after the one-day image and Actions rules, so the group never opens with only the members that aged first
Pin Actions and images by digest on the initial run without waiting for release age
First-party shared workflows and actions pin like any action; a release age adds nothing for a repository we own
Digest moves stay manual in their own group and bypass release age because some datasources provide no timestamps
Majors open only after approval on the Dependency Dashboard and always merge by hand
